title: Shulchan Arukh Yoreh Deah — Wikisource English 145 146 (partial)

changes: Selected paragraphs from two source revisions, removed page navigation and interleaved Hebrew, and escaped text for the reader. Adapted text remains CC BY-SA 4.0.
scope: Selected sections 145:2–7,9 and 146:1–2,4–9,11–15. Sections with Rema glosses are marked partial. 145:1,8 and 146:3,10 are withheld for unclear or conflicting wording. The source page omits the Hebrew for 146:13, whose English was compared directly with the local Hebrew edition. Translation is not independently proofread; source history does not establish the translation method.
